authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (durable decisions), §12.2 (status categories), §12.4 (gate failure is a correct output), §13.3 (no fabricated project facts). Operator instruction in session on 2026-08-15: 'Approve option C, apply it with the syncs.'
supersedes_nothing: This record extends the open-items history of fieldwise-authorisation_2026-08-12.json. It closes the last operator-raised item of the 2026-08-12 placement reframing that still blocked a Phase 8 gate. No prior decision is reversed.
why: Run 5dd0e971 failed gate_10b predicate g09b_p07 (no_unresolved_material_claims): the drafted impact §2.2 asserted that ownership of results generated during the AgroVIR placement is to be settled by written agreement, and honestly carried the claim Unresolved because nothing in Tier 1-4 stated the arrangement. The claim traces to the operator's own open item, the background-IP question on the DrR components, raised at the 2026-08-12 reframing: §2.2 records the DrR components as the fellow's background IP, and the proposal did not address ownership of work done on them inside a commercial partner. An earlier evaluation criticised the IP strategy as insufficiently substantiated, so dropping the assertion from prose was rejected; the operator instead declared the arrangement.
options_considered: Four options were written to plans/reports/p07_placement_ip_declaration_options.md before any change: (A) process-only written-agreement commitment, (B) substantive no-ownership allocation relaying AgroVIR's acceptance, (C) grant-default allocation with a confirmatory agreement, (D) placeholder-class declaration. The operator approved option C. B was not chosen because it relays a third-party acceptance not yet obtained; A because it answers an IP-strategy criticism with a deferral; D because the arrangement is decided, not unknown.

decision.value_summary: Ownership of placement results follows the grant agreement default, vesting in ELTE as the beneficiary acting through the fellow; a written placement agreement between the fellow, ELTE and AgroVIR, concluded before the placement begins, will confirm this allocation and the access terms to the fellow's DrR background IP.
decision.status_basis: Declared rather than Confirmed because the agreement does not yet exist and the default's application to this placement is the operator's adoption, not an extracted Tier 1 rule. If a Tier 1 extraction later confirms the default as a rule, the fact can be promoted and the declaration withdrawn, following the mobility_eligibility precedent of 2026-08-14.
decision.not_a_placeholder: The declaration relays the operator's decided arrangement. It is not registered in _operator_placeholders, because it does not stand in for an answer nobody has supplied.

artifacts_amended.change: Declaration placement_ip_ownership appended (20 -> 21); _extended_by_2026_08_15 note added. No existing declaration altered.

open_for_authorisation background-IP item moves Unresolved -> Assumed, staying listed per the AgroVIR track-record precedent; closed_on_2026_08_15 entry added. The historical AR-3 review text of 2026-08-12 is left as authored.
declarations_standing keys and count synced (20 -> 21) per the packet invariant; two amendments entries added declaring the fingerprint drift of the two Tier 3 artifacts above.

expected_effect_on_gates: The drafter routes the placement-IP claim as unresolved keyed to placement_ip_ownership; the impact assumption-applier flips it to assumed with the declared wording before assembly; g09b_p07 then finds no unresolved claim and g09b_p11 verifies the key-to-declaration mapping. The declaration passes no gate by itself: a future draft that asserts a different IP arrangement, or fails to key the claim, still fails.
what_this_does_not_do: It does not make the arrangement true, and it does not create the written agreement. The allocation is Assumed until the signed agreement or a Tier 1 extraction confirms it, and §2.2 prose must carry it as such. It does not resolve g09b_p06 (Phase-5 communication gap) or g09b_p13 (drafter instruction on declaration-derived facts), which are separate failures of the same run.
